snippet.title: Bootstrap Island - Launch Trailer | PS VR2 Games
snippet.description:
Join the Adventure: 
🌴 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10016753/  

Bootstrap Island is a Robinson Crusoe–inspired VR survival adventure. Shipwrecked on a ruthless 17th-century tropical island, you must survive without guidance. Trust your instincts as you face dangerous wildlife, nature’s fury, and a mysterious local tribe.  

Bootstrap Island is now available on PlayStation VR2!  

#ps5 #psvr2 #psvr2games
